title: Q-FLEETMAP-seed: ultrastable/seed is not equal to its source (1 file(s) differ, 0 missing, 0 only in the copy)
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** fleetmap --drift --apply (daily in tenant-sync.yml)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation fleetmap --probe seed
**Prediction:** fleet_map_drifted_repos <= 0 within 168 h
**Status:** closed

ultrastable/seed is a copy and is not equal to its source (FLEET-MAP-1): 1 file(s) differ, 0 missing, 0 only in the copy.

- differ: SECURITY.md

Fix the sync named in doctrine/fleet-map.json for this repository (never copy by hand), then the same reading closes this item.

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation fleetmap --probe seed

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-27T15:04:37Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 39.7 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
